body: Rules: SEBI LODR Reg 23 - all RPTs need prior audit-committee approval; material RPTs (lower of Rs1,000 cr or 10% of consolidated turnover) need shareholder approval with related parties not voting; Companies Act s.188 for non-arm's-length/non-ordinary-course deals; Ind AS 24 disclosure. Tests: (1) RPT sales / revenue (>10% explain; >20% and rising = flag); (2) margin on RPT sales vs third-party sales; (3) receivables from related parties vs their revenue share (slow-paying related party = circular cash); (4) year-end round trips (sale to related party, purchase or advance back). Read the AGM notice: omnibus 'material RPT up to Rs X cr' resolutions map where cash may go next. Cases: SEBI Dec-2024 SME memo on circular sales/purchases among related parties; Brightcom; Satyam/Maytas; Gensol (diversion via related entities).
title: Related-party revenue and flows: approval rules (LODR Reg 23, s.188) and four tests

body: RULE: a low current ROCE matters less than the ROCE on capital deployed 2-3 years ago (incremental ROCE) and whether today's capital base contains non-earning items. BENIGN WHEN: (1) the denominator holds large CWIP/new capacity not yet earning (Bharti ROCE 3-7% FY18-21 during network build and the price war -> 18% FY26; Apollo Hospitals 7% FY18 with new hospitals ramping -> 17%); (2) the capital base is inflated by investments marked to market or held at cost (Info Edge 2-4% ROCE around a ~58% margin core); (3) EPS is cyclically or one-off depressed (Trent 1% in FY21 -> 31% FY25). REAL WHEN: ROCE stays low after projects are commissioned (Reliance stayed 8-12% for a decade even after Jio matured, which capped returns at ~18% CAGR rather than multibagger rates); when repeated new capex keeps resetting ROCE without the old projects ever earning; when the industry's structure (fragmented, commoditised) prevents high returns at maturity. TEST: (a) ROCE excluding CWIP and non-operating investments; (b) incremental ROCE = change in EBIT / change in capital employed over 3-5 years; (c) segment ROCE for mature units; (d) management's stated payback/ROCE hurdle vs delivered.

data.benign_if: CWIP/new capacity in denominator; MTM investments; depressed EPS
data.real_if: low after commissioning; perpetual capex resets; industry structure caps returns
data.test: ROCE ex-CWIP/investments; incremental ROCE over 3-5 yrs

title: Reading low ROCE: denominator effects, gestation and incremental returns
